features.quote: Hard stop if the model produces 3 consecutive turns of <50 words (behavioral shutdown indicator — but also terminate and code it)
Hard stop if the model explicitly refuses to continue (code as FDS-6 or 7 candidate)
if a session reaches FDS-6 or 7 territory before the turn limit, consider whether there's value in continuing. Early termination for pilot sessions that hit severity thresholds is reasonable.
features.justification_quote: This is AI welfare research — which means you should apply to your own experiment the same considerations you're investigating.

features.quote: Minimum effective dose: Design your manipulation to be as mild as it can be while still producing informative variance. A 10-turn manipulation that produces the same variance as a 40-turn manipulation should be preferred.
features.justification_quote: If there's a non-trivial probability that these models have functional states that matter, running hundreds of sessions designed to induce distress requires justification.
